hook: Did the royal-seat title track where power was held?

claims.text: Savory identifies Tabriz’s early Safavid capital role. Haneda and Matthee distinguish Isfahan’s local offices from the royal household’s transfer and proclamation. Tabriz retained royal-seat terminology, but Ottoman occupation interrupts any blanket continuity claim. Capital titles describe neither every office nor uninterrupted control; the disputed earlier Qazvin transfer year is not resolved here.
